voxy.config.title: Voxy config
voxy.config.general.serviceThreads.toolt: Number of background threads Voxy uses for ingest, saving and mesh building. Higher values trade CPU for faster LoD updates.
voxy.config.general.useSodiumBuilder.too: Allows Voxy to share Sodium's chunk builder threads for LoD mesh generation. Disable to keep Voxy strictly on its own dedicated threads.
voxy.config.general.ingest.tooltip: Enables or disables voxies ability to convert new chunks into LoDs
voxy.config.general.rendering.tooltip: Toggles the LoD renderer. When off, Voxy keeps ingesting and saving but draws nothing.
voxy.config.general.subDivisionSize.tool: Screen-space size threshold (in pixels) below which a LoD section is downgraded to a coarser level. Lower = sharper LoDs but more geometry.
voxy.config.general.quality.tooltip: How far each LoD ring lasts before its downgraded to a lower detail level
voxy.config.general.geometryBuffer.toolt: How many quads the geometry buffer can hold
voxy.config.general.maxSections.tooltip: The max number of sections the renderer can contain
voxy.config.general.renderDistance.toolt: The render distance in chunks (set to -1 to disable chunk unloading)
voxy.config.general.vanilla_fog.tooltip: Apply Minecraft's vanilla fog to LoD chunks. Disable for a cleaner long-distance view.
voxy.config.general.render_statistics.to: Displays Voxy's render-side counters (sections drawn, geometry size, GPU memory) on the F3 debug overlay.
voxy.config.general.nvmesh.tooltip: Use nvidia mesh shaders if possible to render LoDs
voxy.config.threads.ingest.tooltip: How many threads voxy will use for ingesting new chunks
voxy.config.threads.saving.tooltip: How many threads voxy will use for saving sections to the storage backend
voxy.config.threads.render.tooltip: How many threads voxy will use for generating render data
